items.title_kr: Abercrombie와 Hollister, Y2K Nostalgia를 넘어선 Gen Z market 공략 성공
items.title_en: Abercrombie and Hollister Are Winning Over Gen Z, but It’s Bigger Than Y2K Nostalgia
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch와 Hollister가 단순한 Y2K Nostalgia 유행을 넘어선 전략으로 Gen Z 소비자의 지속적인 선택을 받고 있습니다. 당사 sourcing 및 merchandise 기획 시 이들의 지속 성장하는 customer demand 트렌드를 참고해야 합니다.
items.body_en: Abercrombie & Fitch and Hollister continue to capture Gen Z consumer demand beyond simple Y2K nostalgia. Vendor teams should monitor this sustained market momentum for future merchandise planning.

items.title_kr: Macy's, luxury strategy 강화에 힘입어 profit 거의 두 배로 증가
items.title_en: Macy's nearly doubled its profit — here's the luxury strategy behind it
items.body_kr: Macy's nearly doubled its profit through a focused luxury strategy. Vendor teams should analyze how premium merchandise positioning impacts retail margin improvement.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, sales 감소 추세 속에서 private brand 강화 전략 추진
items.title_en: Kohl's Sales Fall Again, Amid New Push On Private Labels
items.body_kr: Kohl's is pushing a new strategy on private labels to counter declining sales. Vendors should closely monitor shifts in private brand sourcing demand from key retail partners.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, footwear category에서 뚜렷한 매출 상승세 기록
items.title_en: How Footwear Is on the Upswing at Kohl’s
items.body_kr: Footwear is experiencing a solid upswing at Kohl's, driving the merchandise mix. Vendor teams should evaluate potential reorders and product line expansions based on category performance.

items.title_kr: Macy's, inventory management 고도화를 위해 AI 시스템 도입 추진
items.title_en: Macy’s To Use AI for Better Inventory Management
items.body_kr: Macy's announced the implementation of AI to drive better inventory management. This tech adoption is expected to improve inventory turnover and optimize lead times across retail channels.

items.title_kr: Hollister, Gloucester Quays에 아울렛 매장 오픈하며 남서부 지역 진출
items.title_en: Hollister makes south west outlet debut at Gloucester Quays
items.body_kr: Hollister made its debut in the south west region with a new outlet store at Gloucester Quays. Vendor teams should assess how physical store expansion supports brand awareness and wholesale volume.
